div.div: 2 تيّههُ i. q. تَوَّهَهِ [and طَيَّحَهُ and طَوَّحَهُ], i. e., He made him to deviate from, or lose, or miss, the right way; made him to lose his way: (Msb:) [or he made him to be, or become, confounded, or perplexed, and unable to see his tight course: &c.: see 1:] he destroyed, or lost, or left or neglected, him or it. (K.) And تيّه نَفْسَهُ He made himself to be, or become, confounded, or perplexed, and unable to see his right course; (S, TA;) as also تَوَّهَهَا and طَوَّحَهَا: (S:) or he destroyed himself. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
